summary: Monroe Capital Income Plus Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its 2026 annual meeting was reconvened and adjourned due to lack of quorum, with no business conducted. The meeting will resume on August 11, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time via virtual platform, with polls remaining open. The record date of April 13, 2026 is unchanged. This is a routine procedural notice regarding an annual meeting adjournment, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic action, or material corporate development is described. The filing is administrative in nature, lacking any deal terms or special-situation characteristics.
